cases.translation: When he is brought to the priest
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Пусть священник велит взять ___ и кедрового дерева
cases.translation: Let the priest command them to take two living clean birds and cedar wood
cases.explain: After the numeral две (two), the genitive plural is required.

cases.sentence: Пусть священник велит убить одну из птиц над ___
cases.translation: Let the priest command them to kill one of the birds over an earthen vessel
cases.explain: The preposition над (over) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Пусть он возьмет живую птицу и погрузит ее вместе с кедровым деревом, алые пряжи и эсопом в кровь ___ убитой над свежей водой
cases.translation: Let him take the living bird and immerse it with cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop in the blood of the bird killed over running water
cases.explain: The genitive case follows the preposition of possession/origin in this context.

cases.sentence: Пусть он семь раз окропит очищаемого от заразной болезни, объявит его чистым и выпустит живую птицу в открытое ___
cases.translation: Let him sprinkle on him who is to be cleansed seven times, pronounce him clean, and let the living bird go into the open field
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) with movement requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: На седьмой день пусть он сбреет все волосы, голову, бороду, брови и остальные волосы из ___
cases.translation: On the seventh day let him shave all his hair, head, beard, eyebrows, and remaining hair
cases.explain: The preposition из (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: На восьмой день он должен принести двух ягнят самцов и одну годовалую самку, всех без изъяна, с тремя десятыми частями ефы лучшей муки, смешанной с ___ для хлебного приношения
cases.translation: On the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without defect, one ewe lamb a year old without defect, three tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Пусть священник возьмет кровь жертвы повинности и помажет ею мочку правого уха очищаемого, большой палец его правой руки и большой палец правой ___
cases.translation: Let the priest take some of the blood of the trespass offering and put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot
cases.explain: The genitive follows the preposition of possession to indicate body parts.

reading.ru: Очищение от заразных кожных болезней Господь сказал Моисею, вот правило о больном во время его очищения.
reading.question: What does the passage establish at the beginning of this chapter?
options: A law for cleansing from contagious skin diseases
Requirements for the Tent of Meeting
reading.correct: A law for cleansing from contagious skin diseases
reading.explain: The opening sentence states the topic is the cleansing rules for skin disease.

reading.ru: Пусть священник велит взять для очищаемого двух живых чистых птиц и кедрового дерева, Алые пряжи и эсопа.
reading.question: What items must the priest command to be taken for the cleansing?
options: Two clean living birds, cedar wood, scarlet thread, and hyssop
A lamb, fine flour, oil, and wine
reading.correct: Two clean living birds, cedar wood, scarlet thread, and hyssop
reading.explain: This sentence specifically lists the required items for the cleansing ritual.

reading.ru: Пусть очищаемый выстирает одежду, сбреет все волосы, вымоется и будет чист.
reading.question: What must the person being cleansed do as part of the ritual?
options: Wash clothes, shave all hair, bathe, and become clean
Make an offering at the altar and fast
Enter the sanctuary and speak to the priest
reading.correct: Wash clothes, shave all hair, bathe, and become clean
reading.explain: The verse describes the washing, shaving, and bathing requirements.

reading.ru: На восьмой день он должен принести двух ягнят самцов и одну годовалую самку, всех без изъяна, с тремя десятыми частями ефы лучшей муки, смешанной с маслом для хлебного приношения и один лок масла.
reading.question: What offerings must be brought on the eighth day?
options: Two male lambs, one-year-old female lamb, fine flour mixed with oil, and a log of oil
One bullock, two goats, and a ram
reading.correct: Two male lambs, one-year-old female lamb, fine flour mixed with oil, and a log of oil
reading.explain: This verse details the specific offerings required for the eighth day of cleansing.

reading.ru: Молодого быка и козла для жертвы за грех, чью кровь внесли в святое святых, чтобы совершить отпущение, нужно вынести из лагеря.
reading.question: What should be done with the bull and goat whose blood was brought into the Holy Place?
options: They should be carried outside the camp
They should be offered again at the altar
They should be divided among the priests
They should be kept for the next sacrifice
reading.correct: They should be carried outside the camp
reading.explain: The text specifies that these animals must be carried outside the camp.

reading.ru: Таковы правила о любой заразной кожной болезни, о лишае, о плесени на одежде и на доме, об опухоли, сыпи и воспалении, чтобы определить чистоту чего-либо.
reading.question: What is the scope of the rules given in this chapter?
options: Rules for skin diseases, leprosy, mildew, swellings, scabs, and bright spots
Rules for worship at the tabernacle
reading.correct: Rules for skin diseases, leprosy, mildew, swellings, scabs, and bright spots
reading.explain: The final verse summarizes all the various conditions covered by the laws in the chapter.
